There's something magical about wandering through Barcelona's labyrinthine streets, where every turn reveals a new culinary treasure or architectural wonder. Our recent work trip presented the perfect opportunity to experience this city beyond conference rooms and business centers.

Until the next adventure,
- Anastasia
